finding.issue: Native GM storage messages could fill the same capped queue used by trusted manager operations, rejecting status, disable and delete controls.
finding.reproduced: All three shutdown regression cases failed with the original runtime after 100 pending GM requests.

fix: Separate bounded admission lanes for manager operations and GM requests; manager FIFO takes priority after the active transaction.
One serialized runner prevents storage writes from racing state changes.
GM pending limits: 64 overall, 16 per requested script ID, 8 per native browser tab across frames; counters release on success and failure.
Malformed messages are rejected before admission; execution rechecks saved capability, grants, native registration and scope.
Both module enable and disable transitions rotate capabilities within the existing verified transaction and rollback.
